note: Germany 5-0 Hungary, UEFA Nations League, Düsseldorf, 7 September 2024 (58th minute). Chapter 1 is keyed from 'A Hungary corner' through 'Germany win' (the clearance), 'Florian Wirtz' and 'looks up' (his control and the look), 'Wirtz plays' (the pass) and 'into his path' (the ball dropping ahead of Musiala) to 'Musiala races', 'all alone' and 'slots it home' (keep the '...' pauses so the run plays near real time). Chapter 2 paints the defenders' line on 'behind the defenders', the feet (red, crossed out) on 'to his feet' and the path (yellow target) on 'into his path'.

chapters.label: The pass, live
chapters.text: Germany against Hungary. A Hungary corner... Germany win the ball. Florian Wirtz looks up. Jamal Musiala is already running. Wirtz plays it forward, into his path! Musiala races away, all alone... and slots it home!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Musiala runs behind the defenders. Wirtz does not pass to his feet. He passes into his path, where he is going.

chapters.label: One on one
chapters.text: Musiala never slows down. He runs and runs, one on one with the keeper... goal!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: look for the run behind the defenders, and pass into their path.
